title: Matrix Structure
governance_note: Review shape, symmetry, sparsity, definiteness, rank, scaling, and conditioning before factorization.

title: Decomposition Choice
governance_note: Match LU, QR, Cholesky, eigen, Schur, SVD, sparse, or low-rank workflow to modeling purpose.

title: Rank and Conditioning
governance_note: Track singular spectra, rank tolerance, condition diagnostics, and near-dependence.

title: Reconstruction and Residuals
governance_note: Check factorization quality, approximation error, and solve residuals.

title: Interpretation Boundaries
governance_note: Prevent factors, components, and modes from being overread as causal or institutional categories.
